The tetragonal phase Y20Mg4Mo16 (Y5MgMo4) crystallizes in space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 40 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mg centers coordinated by four Mo neighbors and Mo centers in octahedral environments with six Y neighbors. Y centers have nine geometric neighbors, predominantly Mo. Corner- and edge-sharing are observed between Mo octahedra, with edge-sharing also between Mg and Mo polyhedra; the periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional.
